نستبحر (form X)
# نَسْتَبْحِرُ (nastabḥiru) /nas.tab.ħi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# نَسْتَبْحِرَ (nastabḥira) /nas.tab.ħi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# نَسْتَبْحِرْ (nastabḥir) /nas.tab.ħir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
